name: HYDRA-UMC-TOOL-CLI
build: Go module root is src/. Build with go build ./cmd/hydra-cli from inside src/.
notes: Real `version`/`status`/`robots`/`config validate`/`config apply --dry-run` commands. `robots`/`status` are genuine clients of a live HYDRA-UMC-SERVER (GET /api/settings, GET /api/hydra-info). A real, stable exit-code contract (exitcode.go) classifies every failure (usage/config/network/server/not-implemented) instead of a bare exit 1. 49 tests via net/http/httptest and real temp-file config fixtures. Fleet-wide deploy/flash-all/audit commands and a live (non-dry-run) `config apply` remain future work, blocked on HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own fleet write endpoints that don't exist yet.
